in_marathi.name: Mrunali
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Gentle and pleasant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mrunali हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Mruna’, meaning 'pleasant' or 'gentle'. This name is associated with the goddess Durga and is believed to bring happiness and good fortune.
